summary: Demis Hassabis announces Gemini Robotics 2, a new suite of robotics models that can reason through movements to perform previously unachievable tasks like tying delicate knots and coordinating on complex workflows.

mechanisms.reason: The post claims robots can now perform tasks 'that weren't possible before', describing a capability threshold crossed in a specific robotics domain.
mechanisms.quote: robots can now reason through every movement to manage tasks that weren’t possible before, like tying delicate knots

practices.reason: The named model suite reasons through movements and coordinates multi-robot workflows, which a team building robotics applications would want to evaluate, though the claim is unreplicated and lab-stated.
practices.quote: robots can now reason through every movement to manage tasks that weren’t possible before, like tying delicate knots - and even team up to solve complex workflows
